definitions.full: H5043. nebrashta נֶבְרַשְׁתָּא noun feminine emphatic the candlestick ( ᵑ7 id. , Syriac , Late Hebrew נַבְרֶשֶׁת ; Arabic is loan-word from Aramaic Frä 95 ; probably foreign word K § 62 Frä 95 Bev and others; ? Assyrian, compare Ba ZA ii. 117 ); — Dan 5:5 .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from an unused root meaning to shine;
